description: Source code for 'sstrip', a utility that removes non-essential parts of ELF files, including section headers and trailing zero bytes, to reduce file size while preserving executable functionality.

methods.name: err
methods.description: Handles error messages, prints to stderr, returns FALSE.

methods.name: readelfheader32
methods.description: Reads ELF32 header and verifies file type and endianness.

methods.name: readphdrtable32
methods.description: Loads program header table for ELF32.

methods.name: getmemorysize32
methods.description: Calculates the last referenced byte in ELF32 to determine file size to keep.

methods.name: modifyheaders32
methods.description: Removes section header references and adjusts program headers for ELF32.

methods.name: commitchanges32
methods.description: Writes updated headers and truncates ELF32 file.

methods.name: readelfheader64
methods.description: Reads ELF64 header and verifies file type and endianness.

methods.name: readphdrtable64
methods.description: Loads program header table for ELF64.

methods.name: getmemorysize64
methods.description: Calculates the last referenced byte in ELF64 to determine file size to keep.

methods.name: modifyheaders64
methods.description: Removes section header references and adjusts program headers for ELF64.

methods.name: commitchanges64
methods.description: Writes updated headers and truncates ELF64 file.

methods.name: truncatezeros
methods.description: Removes trailing zero bytes from the end of the file.
